title: Secret Santa
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this holiday-themed episode, the office prepares for the Christmas party with Dwight and Jim unveiling an artificial tree to boost camaraderie. Phyllis is revealed as the office Santa Claus, sparking conflict with Michael who objects and tries to persuade Jim to take over. Meanwhile, Erin struggles with the chaotic Twelve Days of Christmas gifts from her Secret Santa, later revealed to be Andy. The office votes on who should be Santa, mostly supporting Phyllis, while Michael delivers a controversial Christmas speech. The company announces a sale resulting in executive firings but sparing most employees, leading to mixed reactions. The episode culminates with Phyllis and Bob Vance reconciling as Santas and a festive marching band performance led by Andy for Erin.
